newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil said to strike deal on Minas bank selloffs.
newsitem.headline: Brazil said to strike deal on Minas bank selloffs.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank and the state of Minas Gerais struck a deal Thursday for the selloff of the state's banks, the private Invest News agency reported.
A Central bank spokesman could not immediately confirm the report but said any deal would have to be authorized by the National Monetary Council.
Invest News said the accord involved the privatization of state bank Credireal and larger Banco do Estado de Minas Gerais (BEMGE) and the liquidation of state mortgage bank Minas Caixa.
